title: ITR-3 Schedules DPM, DOA, DEP and DCG (Depreciation) - data
description: Block-wise depreciation under the Income-tax Act, which is computed on blocks of assets and is independent of the depreciation charged in the books.

schedule.description: DPM for plant and machinery, DOA for land, building, furniture and intangibles

rate_percent.description: Block rate: 15, 30, 40 for DPM; 10, 40 for DOA

opening_wdv.description: Column 1, written down value at the start of the year

additions_less_than_180_days.description: Column 4, eligible for half the rate

deductions.description: Column 5, sale proceeds of assets sold from the block

closing_wdv.description: Carried forward as next year opening WDV

capital_gain_on_block.description: Schedule DCG, short-term under section 50 where the block is exhausted
